signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Enter your email and password below to log into your account

validation.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address
validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters long

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.description: Are you sure you want to sign out? You will need to sign in again to access your account.

users.title: Users
users.description: Manage users and their roles here.

createDialog.title: Add User
createDialog.description: Create a user and hand over the one-time initial password.
createDialog.roleHint: You can only create roles below your own.

initialPassword.label: Initial password
initialPassword.shownOnce: Shown only once. The user must change it at first sign-in; it cannot be recovered.

editDialog.title: Edit user
editDialog.description: Change the display name and role of {{email}}.
editDialog.roleHint: You can only assign roles below your own.

disableDialog.title: Disable user
disableDialog.description: All sessions of {{email}} end within 15 minutes at the latest and they cannot sign in; you can re-enable the account at any time.
disableDialog.enableDescription: Re-enable {{email}} so they can sign in again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete user
deleteDialog.description: Permanently delete {{email}} ({{displayName}}) and all of their sessions. This cannot be undone.

resetDialog.title: Reset password
resetDialog.description: Issue a new initial password for {{email}}; all of their sessions end immediately. The enabled flag is not changed.

validation.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address
validation.displayNameTooLong: Display name must not exceed 32 characters

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your profile, password and interface preferences.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: This is how others will see you on the site.
profile.displayNameHint: 1–32 characters. Display only — never used to sign in.
profile.emailHint: The login identifier is managed by administrators and cannot be changed here.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Changing your password ends every session immediately; you will need to sign in again.
password.reloginHint: On success every session (including this browser) is terminated and you sign in again with the new password.
password.forcedTitle: Please set your own new password first
password.forcedDescription: You signed in with a one-time initial password. You must set a new password at first sign-in; the initial password is void afterwards.

toasts.changed: Password changed. Please sign in again with the new password

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Customize the light/dark theme and the interface language.
appearance.themeHint: Choose the light or dark theme; it applies immediately.
appearance.fontHint: Choose the font used across the interface.
appearance.languageHint: Applies immediately; your browser remembers the choice.

forbidden.title: Access Forbidden
forbidden.description: You don't have the necessary permission to view this resource.
